topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I barely recognized the sleek, dark car parked discreetly behind the old maple tree, its polished surface gleaming under the sparse sunlight. It wasn't the kind of vehicle you'd expect to see on our quiet street, where most of us make do with aging sedans and the occasional rusted pickup. Then I noticed the changes to their house—subtle but telling. The overgrown garden suddenly neat, the fading paint on the shutters now a fresh, crisp white. It made my pulse quicken. I tried to shake off the unease, forcing a smile as I passed by their now meticulously maintained fence. Why would anyone go to such lengths to keep their wealth hidden? It didn’t sit right, gnawing at the back of my mind like a nagging suspicion I couldn’t ignore.
